components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Safe, high-priority action with restrained mint emphasis.
components.html: <button class="ds-btn-primary" type="button"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="17" height="17" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M12 5v14M5 12h14"/></svg>New asset</button>
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; min-height: 44px; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; padding: 10px 14px; border: 1px solid var(--accent, #53c7a2); border-radius: 8px; color: var(--button-accent-foreground, #0d141d); background: var(--accent, #53c7a2); font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Segoe UI, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 650; line-height: 1; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 140ms ease, border-color 140ms ease, transform 140ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent, #53c7a2) 88%, white); border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent, #53c7a2) 88%, white); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus, #8ccaff); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { cursor: not-allowed; opacity: 0.56; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Default bounded action for routine management choices.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; min-height: 44px; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; padding: 10px 14px; border: 1px solid var(--line, #2a394b); border-radius: 8px; color: var(--text-strong, #edf3f7); background: var(--surface-raised, #1c2939); font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Segoe UI, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 650; line-height: 1; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 140ms ease, border-color 140ms ease, transform 140ms ease; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--surface-raised, #1c2939) 86%, var(--text-strong, #edf3f7)); border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--line, #2a394b) 72%, var(--text, #c2ccd6)); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus, #8ccaff); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-secondary:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-btn-secondary:disabled { cursor: not-allowed; opacity: 0.56; }

components.name: Quiet Button
components.description: Low-emphasis action that remains invisible until interaction.
components.css: .ds-btn-quiet { display: inline-flex; min-height: 44px; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; padding: 10px 14px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 8px; color: var(--text, #c2ccd6); background: transparent; font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Segoe UI, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 650; line-height: 1; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 140ms ease, color 140ms ease, transform 140ms ease; } .ds-btn-quiet:hover { color: var(--text-strong, #edf3f7); background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--surface-raised, #1c2939) 76%, transparent); } .ds-btn-quiet:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus, #8ccaff); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-quiet:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-btn-quiet:disabled { cursor: not-allowed; opacity: 0.56; }

components.name: Danger Button
components.description: Irreversible confirmation action reserved for destructive outcomes.
components.html: <button class="ds-btn-danger" type="button"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="17" height="17" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M3 6h18M8 6V4h8v2M19 6l-1 14H6L5 6M10 11v5M14 11v5"/></svg>Remove asset</button>
components.css: .ds-btn-danger { display: inline-flex; min-height: 44px; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; padding: 10px 14px; border: 1px solid var(--danger, #f26464); border-radius: 8px; color: var(--button-danger-foreground, #190809); background: var(--danger, #f26464); font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Segoe UI, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 650; line-height: 1; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 140ms ease, border-color 140ms ease, transform 140ms ease; } .ds-btn-danger:hover { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--danger, #f26464) 88%, white); border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--danger, #f26464) 88%, white); } .ds-btn-danger:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus, #8ccaff); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-danger:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-btn-danger:disabled { cursor: not-allowed; opacity: 0.56; }

components.name: Input Field
components.description: Compact labeled field with a seam-based focus and error treatment.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 7px; color: var(--text-strong, #edf3f7); font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Segoe UI, sans-serif; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 650; line-height: 1.25; } .ds-field input { width: 100%; min-height: 44px; padding: 10px 12px; border: 1px solid var(--line, #2a394b); border-radius: 8px; outline: none; color: var(--text-strong, #edf3f7); background: var(--surface-input, #121c28); font: inherit; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 400; transition: border-color 140ms ease, box-shadow 140ms ease; } .ds-field input::placeholder { color: var(--text-muted, #8795a5); opacity: 1; } .ds-field input:hover { border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--line, #2a394b) 60%, var(--text-muted, #8795a5)); } .ds-field input:focus-visible { border-color: var(--focus, #8ccaff); box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px color-mix(in srgb, var(--focus, #8ccaff) 30%, transparent); } .ds-field input[aria-invalid="true"] { border-color: var(--danger, #f26464); } .ds-field small { color: var(--text-muted, #8795a5); font-size: 12px; font-weight: 400; line-height: 1.45; }

components.name: Success Status Badge
components.description: Text-and-icon status pill for affirmative operational state.
components.html: Connected
components.css: .ds-status-success { display: inline-flex; min-height: 28px; align-items: center; gap: 6px; padding: 4px 10px; border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent, #53c7a2) 34%, transparent); border-radius: 999px; color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent, #53c7a2) 82%, var(--text-strong, #edf3f7)); background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent, #53c7a2) 11%, transparent); font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Segoe UI, sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 650; line-height: 1.15; }

components.name: Panel
components.description: Flat, seam-bounded container for related operational facts.
components.css: .ds-panel { overflow: hidden; border: 1px solid var(--line, #2a394b); border-radius: 12px; color: var(--text, #c2ccd6); background: var(--surface-panel, #172231); font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Segoe UI, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; } .ds-panel header { min-height: 54px; padding: 16px 18px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line, #2a394b); color: var(--text-strong, #edf3f7); font-size: 16px; font-weight: 620; } .ds-panel dl { margin: 0; padding: 8px 18px 14px; } .ds-panel dl div { display: flex; min-height: 50px; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 16px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line, #2a394b); } .ds-panel dl div:last-child { border-bottom: 0; } .ds-panel dt { color: var(--text-muted, #8795a5); } .ds-panel dd { margin: 0; color: var(--text-strong, #edf3f7); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }

components.name: Active Navigation Item
components.description: Selected desktop rail destination with a narrow mint state seam.
components.html: Assets
components.css: .ds-nav-item { position: relative; display: flex; min-height: 46px; align-items: center; gap: 13px; padding: 0 13px; border-radius: 8px; color: var(--text-muted, #8795a5); background: transparent; font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Segoe UI, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; text-decoration: none; transition: color 160ms ease, background 160ms ease; } .ds-nav-item:hover { color: var(--text-strong, #edf3f7); background: var(--surface-hover, #213044); } .ds-nav-item:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus, #8ccaff); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-nav-item.is-active { color: var(--text-strong, #edf3f7); background: var(--surface-selected, #26384b); } .ds-nav-item.is-active::before { position: absolute; inset: 10px auto 10px -10px; width: 2px; border-radius: 2px; background: var(--accent, #53c7a2); content: ""; }

components.name: Selected Asset Row
components.description: Signature inventory row whose inset mint seam joins selection to the inspector.
components.css: .ds-asset-row { display: grid; width: 100%; min-height: 59px; grid-template-columns: minmax(190px, 1.35fr) 92px minmax(150px, 1fr) minmax(130px, 0.8fr) minmax(120px, 0.85fr); align-items: center; gap: 10px; padding: 0 16px; border: 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line, #2a394b); color: var(--text, #c2ccd6); background: transparent; font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Segoe UI, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; text-align: left; cursor: pointer; } .ds-asset-row:hover { background: var(--surface-hover, #213044); } .ds-asset-row:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus, #8ccaff); outline-offset: -2px; } .ds-asset-row.is-selected { background: var(--surface-selected, #26384b); box-shadow: inset 2px 0 var(--accent, #53c7a2); } .ds-asset-row > * { min-width: 0; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-asset-name { display: grid; } .ds-asset-name strong { color: var(--text-strong, #edf3f7); font-weight: 600; } .ds-asset-name small { color: var(--text-muted, #8795a5); font-size: 11px; } .ds-asset-row code { color: var(--text-strong, #edf3f7); font-family: SFMono-Regular, Consolas, Liberation Mono, monospace; font-size: 14px; } .ds-asset-state { color: var(--accent-strong, #76d7b7); }

components.name: Selected Host Trust Row
components.description: Selected TOFU record with exact host identity, key algorithm, abbreviated SHA256 fingerprint, and a persistent mint selection seam.
components.css: .ds-host-row { display: grid; width: 100%; min-height: 64px; grid-template-columns: minmax(145px, 1.1fr) minmax(115px, .86fr) minmax(180px, 1.35fr) minmax(112px, .78fr); align-items: center; gap: 14px; padding: 8px 14px; border: 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line, #2a394b); color: var(--text, #c2ccd6); background: transparent; font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Segoe UI, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; text-align: left; cursor: pointer; } .ds-host-row:hover { background: var(--surface-hover, #213044); } .ds-host-row:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus, #8ccaff); outline-offset: -2px; } .ds-host-row.is-selected { background: var(--surface-selected, #26384b); box-shadow: inset 2px 0 var(--accent, #53c7a2); } .ds-host-row > * { min-width: 0; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-host-identity { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; } .ds-host-identity > svg { box-sizing: content-box; padding: 8px; border-radius: 8px; color: var(--accent-strong, #76d7b7); background: var(--accent-soft, #183c37); } .ds-host-identity span { min-width: 0; } .ds-host-identity strong, .ds-host-identity small { display: block; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; } .ds-host-identity strong { color: var(--text-strong, #edf3f7); font-weight: 650; } .ds-host-identity small, .ds-host-row time { color: var(--text-muted, #8795a5); font-size: 12px; } .ds-host-row code { color: var(--text-strong, #edf3f7); font-family: SFMono-Regular, Consolas, Liberation Mono, monospace; font-size: 12px; }

narrative.overview:
Hop is one calm control surface: a matte blue-charcoal shell that puts instance state, Catalog records, ownership, and safe action into a continuous operational workspace. It should feel like a well-kept systems ledger rather than a generic metrics dashboard—compact, factual, low-glare, and easy to scan for long sessions.

Brand character comes from precision: hairline seams, restrained mint, workhorse typography, tabular operational values, and a selected row that joins the inventory to a persistent inspector. Light mode changes contrast, not hierarchy or semantics. The interface avoids gradients, translucent glass surfaces, display-scale typography, and decorative effects that compete with the data.
keyCharacteristics: Matte graphite and blue-charcoal layers with a matched light theme.
One restrained mint accent for connection, selection, and safe primary action.
Compact tables, 42–44px controls, and 54–64px operational rows.
Hairline seams and tonal layering before shadows.
The desktop rail becomes a bottom dock; the Assets inspector becomes URL-driven full-screen mobile detail.
Status always uses text and icon in addition to color.

rules.name: The Signal Budget Rule
rules.body: Mint marks connected, selected, configured, or safely actionable state; amber marks attention; red is reserved for failure and destructive outcomes; blue carries guidance and focus. Never invent a status the transport does not provide merely to add color.

rules.name: The Workhorse Type Rule
rules.body: Keep information-bearing text on the documented 10–24px ramp, reserve the 10px step for short micro-labels, and do not introduce display typography or decorative font pairings.

rules.name: The Shell Transformation Rule
rules.body: Preserve navigation, state, and selection across the 224px rail, 76px rail, and mobile dock modes; responsive adaptation changes presentation, never the operator's place in the task.

rules.name: The Flat-by-Default Rule
rules.body: Do not shadow resting panels or rows. Introduce elevation only when a surface temporarily sits above the workspace or must preserve spatial context during a task.

rules.name: The Compact Geometry Rule
rules.body: Keep persistent working surfaces between 8px and 12px, reserve 14–16px for transient layers, and use pills only for compact statuses, tags, or mode badges.

rules.name: The Verified Reset Rule
rules.body: Never frame reset as a connection test, key replacement, or mismatch repair. It removes one stored fingerprint only; the next managed connection establishes whatever host key it receives as the new TOFU record.

rules.name: The Durable State Rule
rules.body: Every active, selected, warning, destructive, ownership, and connection state must remain understandable without color and must survive responsive transformation.

dos: Do lead with current instance and Catalog state before configuration chrome.
Do use matte semantic layers, 1px seams, and the 12px page rhythm to keep dense screens readable.
Do preserve the same color meanings and prominence order in both dark and light themes.
Do use tabular figures for operational counts, timestamps, durations, ports, and revisions.
Do keep Assets mobile detail URL-driven, full-screen, and bounded between the 58px top bar and the dock safe area.
Do label synthetic demo facts and show only capabilities or status that the transport actually provides.
donts: Don't use gradients, translucent glass surfaces, ambient glow, or decorative shadows.
Don't introduce large display type, ornamental font pairings, or marketing-dashboard language.
Don't turn every row into a floating card; keep compact tables and seam-separated ledgers.
Don't spend mint on decoration or use red for anything short of failure, validation, or destructive action.
Don't fabricate asset health, audit events, connection tests, secret reveal, or other real-API capabilities. Ownership comes only from the real `local | config` API field.
Don't collapse desktop navigation or inspectors without preserving routes, selected resource state, and keyboard access.
